run.change_description: fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching

summary.intent: Make parseBody() and validator() match form/JSON Content-Type media types case-insensitively while leaving parameters such as multipart boundaries intact (issue #5060).
summary.issue_fit: Partial: mixed-case media types are now accepted for parseBody and validator, but the new parseFormData path breaks parseBody after c.req.formData() has cached the body.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (6 files) reviewed. Reviewer-executed at head: vitest on body, buffer, validator, request, method-override and hono test files all pass; scratch probes showed the confirmed regression at head against correct output at the merge-base. Runtime suites for Deno, Bun and Workers were unavailable. Repository guidance: only .github/pull_request_template.md exists at the merge-base; it adds no review rule.

findings.title: Keep parseBody working after c.req.formData() has cached the body
findings.trigger: A handler or middleware awaits `c.req.formData()` and then `c.req.parseBody()` on a multipart or urlencoded POST.
findings.impact: Multipart: parseBody throws 'no boundary found in multipart body' and the route returns 500. Urlencoded: it returns an object keyed by a generated multipart boundary. At the merge-base the same sequence returned the correct fields.
findings.change: In `parseFormData`, when the request is a `HonoRequest`, reuse `request.formData()` (which honours `bodyCache.formData`) and apply the media-type normalization only when parsing raw bytes, instead of always calling `arrayBuffer()`, which re-serializes a cached FormData with a new boundary.
findings.source: Issue #5060, expected behavior (no regression to form parsing).

observations.fact: `methodOverride` still guards its form parsing with case-sensitive `startsWith('multipart/form-data')` and `startsWith('application/x-www-form-urlencoded')`, so mixed-case media types skip the override; the issue names only parseBody and validator.

requirements.evidence: src/utils/body.ts:104-106 and src/validator/validator.ts:24-26 match case-insensitively; parseFormData regresses the cached-formData path (src/utils/body.ts:126).
src/utils/buffer.ts:113 lowercases only /^[^;]+/; src/utils/buffer.test.ts mixed-case boundary test passes.
src/utils/body.test.ts, src/validator/validator.test.ts add mixed-case urlencoded, multipart and JSON cases; all pass at head.
